summary: Leadership narrowed to a handful of names. Conviction is kept moderate until breadth improves.

pick.thesis: Linde keeps making higher lows while the benchmark chops sideways. Pullbacks have been bought quickly, which suggests persistent demand rather than a one-off gap.
risks: Momentum reversal after an extended run
pick.invalidation: A close back below the recent range low while the benchmark holds firm.

pick.thesis: CME Group has lagged the benchmark across the lookback window and recent rebounds faded fast. The weakness looks persistent rather than a single event.
